name: filtergc
description: Searches live garbage-collected tables or functions that match the supplied filters. filterType must be "table" or "function". options must be a table.

parameters.name: filterType
parameters.description: GC object type to search. The value is lowercased and must be "table" or "function".

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Filter table. Function searches read Name, Hash, StartLine, IgnoreExecutor, IgnoreSyn, Environment, Constants, and Upvalues. Table searches read Metatable, Keys, Values, and KeyValuePairs.

parameters.name: returnOne
parameters.description: When true, returns the first matching object or nil instead of an array table.
